newsitem.title: ITALY: TENNIS-KAFELNIKOV BOOED OFF COURT IN ITALIAN OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KAFELNIKOV BOOED OFF COURT IN ITALIAN OPEN.

text.p: French Open champion and number four seed Yevgeny Kafelnikov, struggling for form after a three month lay-off with a broken finger, lost in straight sets in the Italian Open on Thursday to Spain's Alberto Berasategui.
The Russian, who now has not taken a set off the 1994 French Open runner-up in five matches, surrendered the third round tie in just over an hour 6-3 6-2 and was booed off the centre court.
In just three rounds, Italians have seen their premier tennis tournament lose its top five seeds.

The world's top two players Pete Sampras and Michael Chang, both American, were eliminated in the first round and Austria's Thomas Muster and Dutchman Richard Krajicek, the Wimbledon champion, were knocked out on Wednesday.
Kafelnikov has played just five tournaments this season after breaking his finger on a punch-bag in January. He reached the semifinals in Hamburg last week.
